name: David Perez
text: Ricardo and the entire team at Mr. Painting Houses exceeded every expectation I had. They completed the exterior repaint of my home in Gilbert, and the quality of their work was truly top-notch. My house had severe fading, peeling, and cracking. The foundation was in poor condition and required extensive patching, and the eaves and fascia had significant peeling and cracking. Ricardo's team properly repaired everything, sealed the damaged areas, applied an elastomeric coating to the fascia for long-lasting protection, and completely transformed the appearance of my home. Their attention to detail, preparation, professionalism, and craftsmanship were outstanding from start to finish. If you're looking for a painting company that truly cares about quality and delivers exceptional results, I highly recommend Mr. Painting Houses. Thank you, Ricardo, and the entire Mr. Painting Houses team for an amazing job!
